recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future cleanup of minor wording such as nested quotation marks or the spelling of heartrate should be handled as a separate editorial tracker, not as unfinished FHIR-24105 work.
issue_request: FHIR-24105 asked why MedicationAdministration.supportingInformation and MedicationDispense.supportingInformation are present in core when their descriptions did not explain purpose or use. The Published/Persuasive R5 resolution kept the elements as part of the 80% and required updated descriptions with better examples.
initial_application: Jira records the work as committed on 2019-12-12 in HL7/fhir commit 80c2f73ea490c414129d8406d6d00d4e94af04c0. That commit expanded the old medication administration and dispense spreadsheet definitions with a heart-rate-at-administration example and a lab-test/weight-before-dispense example. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later moved that applied text into the current StructureDefinition XML source during the R5 source rework.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes medicationadministration and medicationdispense. Pharmacy minutes from 2019-11-25 confirm the WG found inpatient and outpatient use cases, including REMS, and decided to leave both elements in while improving descriptions. Direct Zulip searches found no issue-specific or conflicting discussion. The other Jira keys sharing the 80c2f73 commit concern unrelated pharmacy changes and were not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active source already explains MedicationAdministration.supportingInformation with patient characteristics and heart-rate context at administration time, and MedicationDispense.supportingInformation with lab-test completion and patient-weight documentation before dispensing.
